title: The Viral “Miracle” That Was Just Stage Magic
tags: boy in boiling water viral video explained
description:
A viral video once showed a young boy sitting calmly in a vessel of “boiling water,” promoted as proof of spiritual powers. Millions were amazed, with some calling it a miracle. But was this spectacle real?

In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts breaks down the trick. The water only bubbles in one spot, the flowers remain unaffected, and no steam rises from the pot. The boy shows no signs of burns — which is impossible if the water was truly boiling. The secret? A hollow vessel with a hidden chamber, possibly filled with a small amount of water. An air pump or aquarium pump can create fake “boiling” bubbles while the outer pot heats slowly.

This is nothing but an old stage magic trick dressed up as spirituality to fool the gullible. Just as rationalists like A.T. Kovoor, Narendra Dabholkar, and Sanal Edamaruku exposed similar frauds, this video shows how pseudoscience and theatrics still thrive in the internet age. Real boiling water is for making Maggi noodles — not miracle boys.
